title: Open Atrekos schemas
description: Every JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) Atrekos offers, with the Atrekos versions it covers. Each `$id` is the address of the file.

schemas.name: archive-manifest
schemas.description: `manifest.json` of an assessment archive: the engine version, the input hash, the pinned catalogue versions, the evidence status and a SHA-256 for every file.

schemas.name: archive-provenance
schemas.description: `provenance.json` of an assessment archive: the only file that carries internal identifiers (with `localKeys`, the map from each local key the rest of the archive uses to its identifier), the approval, the snapshot generations and `pdfsWithDatabaseId`, the frozen PDFs that print the assessment id. Deleting it leaves the rest of the archive verifiable.

schemas.name: archive-input
schemas.description: The `input/` directory of an assessment archive as one object keyed by file path, YAML files parsed (assets, interfaces and the organisation are named by local keys): answers, mitigations, treatments, quality acceptances, condition hand-overs, the TOE, tracing, the model and catalogue snapshots, and the pinned frameworks when there are any.

schemas.name: engine-result
schemas.description: The engine result (`output/engine-result.json`, the API `result` body): initial and residual risks, treatments, quality indicators, tracing, and the report projections including one projection per pinned framework. The projections carry an outcome and a verdict per control; framework text appears only as the framework's own text policy allows.

schemas.name: pack-artifact
schemas.description: A provisioning artifact: a pack, a model snapshot, five catalogue versions, and the frameworks the pack's revision assigns by label and content digest. Envelope versions 1 and 2 are refused by the loader and are not offered.

schemas.name: pack-artifact
schemas.description: A provisioning artifact like version 3, whose model may also record an attack-potential option's engine key, definition, reference level and deviation rationale, and each factor's next ordinal. It is written only when it records one of them; otherwise the artifact is version 3.

schemas.name: pack-artifact
schemas.description: A provisioning artifact like version 4, in which an attack step's estimate and a countermeasure's or assumption's contribution refer to an attack-potential option by its engine key (not a label and a copied number), every option carries its key, and each factor records its next ordinal. It is the only version written; versions 3 and 4 are read through a converter.

schemas.name: pack-artifact
schemas.description: A provisioning artifact like version 5, in which an assumption or a countermeasure may also carry a `comment`: why it is rated as it is. It is the only version written; versions 3, 4 and 5 are read.

schemas.name: pack-artifact
schemas.description: A provisioning artifact like version 6, in which an attack step may also carry `frameworkControlIds`: the framework controls it is bound to, as an assumption or a countermeasure does. It is the only version written; versions 3 to 6 are read.

schemas.name: framework-file
schemas.description: A framework library file: one descriptor and its controls. This schema is the shape level (VX-schema). The rules beyond shape stay in the application and run on upload: VX1 unique control ids, VX2 parents that exist and no cycles, VX3 declared levels, VX4 declared attribute values, VX5 relations that resolve, VX6 binding coverage, VX7 the text policy and its allowed processing.

schemas.name: atrekos-stix-extension
schemas.description: The property extension a STIX 2.1 pack export carries (#776 M4): the whole attack step or countermeasure on its attack-pattern or course-of-action, and on the identity that stands for the pack its questions, damage scenarios, assumptions, licence, provenance and the lossy-projection marker. The pack artifact, not the STIX bundle, is canonical.
